verdict.rationale: The pack documents no full-account data export, bulk download, or offboarding and portability feature. The Card Expenses and Bills APIs only expose specific record types through the API for ERP sync, which is a developer building block for a subset of data, not an export of all data in open formats. Webhooks are event notifications, not data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
